E0120

`name` was not moved here, so it cannot fill this owning destination

What

`name` was not moved here, so it cannot fill this owning destination

Why

Read access does not transfer ownership; cloneable values copy automatically at ordinary owning destinations, but this value needs an explicit ownership decision

Fix

Write `~name` for an owning copy, add `^` to the parameter when it should take ownership, or remove `copies: .Explicit` for the default materialization

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0120: tests/ui/borrowed_mutable_view_enum_pattern.stderr.

Error [E0120]: `choice` was not moved here, so its contents cannot be taken apart
  --> tests/ui/borrowed_mutable_view_enum_pattern.jet:7:8
    |
  7 |     if choice == {
    |        ^^^^^^
 Why: `choice` grants read-only access to `Choice`, so its non-copyable parts cannot be taken apart with the move marker `^`
 Fix: change the parameter to `choice: ^Choice` with the move marker `^`, or inspect it without binding its contents
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0120

Error [E0116]: `print` doesn't hand back a value
  --> tests/ui/borrowed_mutable_view_enum_pattern.jet:8:29
    |
  8 |         .First(selected) -> print(selected[0])
    |                             ^^^^^
 Why: a call is a value only when its function declares a result after the parameter list
 Fix: inside an arm, wrap the call in `{ … }`; otherwise put `print` on its own line, or declare it as `fn print(…) Type -> …`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0116
